Compute budget limits and instruction execution helpers.

# Purpose
This header declares the interface for the compute budget program in the Flamenco runtime. It defines constants for heap frame limits, heap granularity, and the maximum compute unit limit, along with program kind values used to set default compute unit limits for builtins and non-builtins. The file also declares functions that validate and sanitize compute budget requests and execute compute budget instructions for a transaction or instruction context.
